name: Naraku
source: A priest with a love for corruption and humans. Follows a peculiar religion promoting the use of evil, which has the motto of "one bad act a day". A bit infamously known for fllirting with the sisters at his church despite not wanting to actually go out with them. Has an additional mouth on his left hand, which is usually covered by a glove with a zipper.
